dedupe_keys.name: geothermal project on tu delft campus del gt 02 s2 cased hole micro frac tests

description: TU Delft publishes cased-hole micro-fracture stress tests from the reservoir section of geothermal injector DEL-GT-02-S2. The provider describes tests after perforation and before cooling during completion of the campus geothermal doublet. The release includes reservoir-characterisation measurements, composite log images and well-log files. LAS and DLIS are instrument and well-log formats; they are not lidar point-cloud files. Coverage: Coverage is the Delft campus site in the Netherlands. The description dates the campaign to November 2025, while the custom time-coverage field says 2026. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: The two source dates conflict and are retained without silently choosing one. Exact sampling intervals and test interpretation were not independently checked. Simulation uses include reservoir stress-state calibration for geothermal operation. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
